old_caption: The video showcases a series of six black spotlights mounted on a horizontal bar, evenly spaced along the wall. The lights are illuminated, casting a bright white light that contrasts against the darker surroundings. The ceiling above is plain and white, providing a neutral backdrop for the lighting fixture. In the foreground, a computer screen displays a user interface with Japanese text, indicating a control panel for managing the lights. The interface lists two items: "リビング電球" (Living Room Bulb) and "テーブライト" (Table Light), each with options to turn them on or off and adjust their color temperature. The scene remains static throughout the video, focusing on the illuminated lights and the control panel, suggesting a demonstration or tutorial on controlling smart home lighting systems.

caption: The video showcases a diagonal black track of six spotlight fixtures mounted near a ceiling, every one of them switched on and emitting a cool blue-white light against a plain wall. The glow from each lamp pools softly on the surface below, and these illuminated patches hold their shape and brightness throughout the excerpt. In the lower-left corner, a Japanese smart-lighting control panel remains overlaid, headed by the group list label and showing two named groups, a living-room lighting row with a white color swatch and a table-light row with a red swatch. Each row keeps its ON/OFF toggle and color-switch buttons visible and unchanged. The camera framing stays fixed, with the track, ceiling line, and overlay holding constant positions relative to one another. No lighting state changes occur, leaving the scene in a steady all-on condition for the entire duration.
